items.stem: Under IFRS, which measurement basis records an asset at the amount of cash that would be received to sell it in an orderly transaction?

options.rationale: Correct: fair value is the price to sell an asset in an orderly transaction between market participants.
Historical cost is the original amount paid.
Present value discounts future cash flows.
Replacement cost is the amount to replace an asset.

items.explanation: Correct: fair value is the price to sell an asset in an orderly transaction between market participants.

items.stem: When a parent acquires a subsidiary, goodwill on consolidation is calculated as:

options.text: Consideration plus non-controlling interest less the fair value of net assets acquired
options.rationale: Correct: this is the standard goodwill computation on acquisition.

options.text: Consideration less share capital of the subsidiary
options.rationale: This ignores fair values and NCI.

options.text: Fair value of net assets less consideration
Retained earnings of the subsidiary at acquisition
options.rationale: Retained earnings alone do not measure goodwill.

items.explanation: Correct: this is the standard goodwill computation on acquisition.

items.stem: Select TWO items that are presented within other comprehensive income under IFRS.

options.text: A revaluation surplus on property, plant and equipment
options.rationale: Correct: PPE revaluation gains are recognised in OCI.

options.text: Remeasurements of a defined benefit pension plan
options.rationale: Correct: defined benefit remeasurements are in OCI.
Cost of sales is in profit or loss.
Revenue is in profit or loss.
Finance costs are in profit or loss.

items.explanation: Correct: PPE revaluation gains are recognised in OCI.
